about.title: About me
about.summary: I'm a full-stack developer with a bachelor's degree in Control and Automation Engineering and Systems Analysis and Development. My main focus today is building web applications for desktop and mobile devices using the latest market technologies.

spa.title: Single Page Application (SPA)
spa.description: I develop responsive web apps such as landing pages, online stores or dashboards. Transform your digital vision into reality with a personalized touch.

api.title: API Development
api.description: I develop robust and scalable APIs to power your web applications. With experience, I ensure efficient and secure integrations between front-end and back-end. I customize solutions to your specific needs. Take your digital infrastructure to the next level.

database.title: Database
database.description: I offer custom database development services tailored to your specific needs. As a full stack developer, I design efficient and scalable solutions for data storage and management.
